Greenville Bike & Tri Saturday Shop Ride

Greenville, SC · Road

Greenville Bike & Tri Saturday Shop Ride is a road group ride in Greenville, SC. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Greenville Bike & Tri. About 30 miles, a and B groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a and B groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @greenvillebikeandtri the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Greenville Bike & Tri Saturday Shop Ride group ride

A two-hour, 30-mile road ride from the shop with A and B groups. The route file is on the shop's site. Cancellations go up on the shop's Facebook and Instagram.
